**PRIOR AUTHORIZATION DETERMINATION**

**Decision: APPROVED**

**Service:** Laparoscopic Roux-en-Y gastric bypass (CPT 43644)  
**Order Date:** March 15, 2025  
**Patient:** [Patient Name]

---

Your prior authorization request for laparoscopic Roux-en-Y gastric bypass has been **APPROVED**.

**Criteria Met:**

**BMI Requirement:** Met. Current BMI is 37.9 kg/m² (documented obs-002), exceeding the required minimum of 35 kg/m².

**Comorbidity Requirement:** Met. Patient has documented obesity-related comorbidities: Essential hypertension (I10, active since 7/1/2022) and osteoarthritis of the knee (M17.11, active since 2/15/2016), both listed as qualifying conditions.

**Prior Conservative Treatment:** Met. Medical record documents completion of a 6-month physician-supervised weight management program including dietitian visits and phentermine trial. Weight loss was minimal and non-sustained (2 kg net loss, regained after discontinuation), documented as unsuccessful.

**Covered Procedure:** Met. Laparoscopic Roux-en-Y gastric bypass is a covered bariatric procedure.

This authorization is valid for 60 days from this letter. Please schedule the procedure within this timeframe and notify us of the scheduled date.
